## PO Number (P#)

The immutable document identity referenced on packing slips, invoices, and audits. Snapshot pattern (same as Invoice Number): AwardRfqCommand stamps it exactly once at issue via `nextPoNumber()` and nothing ever recomputes it. Renders mono/tabular in every format so a PO number reads as a reference.

### Example

A primitive StringField cannot carry `containedExamples` — see the linked PurchaseOrder PO-2026-0042, whose number this field renders in the header, rows, and fitted views.

### Non-goals

No global sequence service — the year-scoped generator is collision-tolerant at demo scale and says so in its code. No barcode/QR rendering.
